dialogue.content: （こんにちは、本日はよろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたら始めさせていただきますね。）
dialogue.English: (Hello, thank you for joining me today. We'll begin when it's time.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそどうぞよろしくお願いします）
dialogue.English: (Thank you, I'm looking forward to our session as well.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。よろしくお願いします。はじめに年齢、性別、相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you. To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to talk about?

dialogue.content: 11さい、男です
dialogue.English: I'm 11 years old, and I'm a boy.

dialogue.content: お返事ありがとう、小学5年生かな？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing. Are you in the 5th grade?

dialogue.content: はい、5年です
dialogue.English: Yes, 5th grade.

dialogue.content: あの
dialogue.English: Um...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: うちのあたらしいお父さんが弟ばかりかわいがって
dialogue.English: My new dad only dotes on my little brother.

dialogue.content: うんうん（聞いています）
dialogue.English: Mm-hm (I'm listening).

dialogue.content: すごくうちにいるのが嫌なんです
dialogue.English: I really hate being at home.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、嫌だし寂しいよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must feel awful and lonely.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 弟は僕もかわいいんですけど
dialogue.English: I think my little brother is cute, too, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 弟だけいろいろ買ってもらったり
dialogue.English: He's the only one who gets things bought for him,

dialogue.content: どこか連れていってもらったりして
dialogue.English: and he's the only one who gets taken places.

dialogue.content: そっか、、、。それは悲しくなってしまうよね。
dialogue.English: I see... That would make anyone feel sad.

dialogue.content: やっばり本当のお父さんじゃないからかな
dialogue.English: I wonder if it's because he's not my real dad after all.

dialogue.content: 最近はあまり口もきいてくれないし
dialogue.English: Lately, he doesn't talk to me much, either.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そんなふうに感じてしまうんだね。前は、新しいお父さんはあなたにどんな感じだったかな？
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how it feels to you. What was your new dad like with you before?

dialogue.content: 前　うーん
dialogue.English: Before... hmm.

dialogue.content: 弟さんが生まれる前のこと、、どうかな？
dialogue.English: How about before your little brother was born?

dialogue.content: ちょっと憶えてないけど　でももう少しやさしかった気がする
dialogue.English: I don't really remember, but I think he was a little kinder.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。弟さんは何歳？
dialogue.English: I see. How old is your little brother?

dialogue.content: 5さい
dialogue.English: 5 years old.

dialogue.content: そっか、かわいいよね。5年前からお父さんは変わったのかな？
dialogue.English: I see, that's a cute age. Did your dad change five years ago?

dialogue.content: うん、弟は遊んであげたりします
dialogue.English: Yeah. I play with my little brother sometimes.

dialogue.content: えらいね。さすがお兄ちゃんだね。
dialogue.English: That's wonderful. You're such a good big brother.

dialogue.content: 5年前、かなあんまりおぼえてないけど、おとうさんが嫌だなって思ったのはそんなに前でもないかも
dialogue.English: Five years ago, maybe... I don't really remember, but I don't think it was that long ago that I started disliking my dad.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、嫌だなと感じるのは最近なんだね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you've been feeling this way more recently.

dialogue.content: 多分
dialogue.English: Probably.

dialogue.content: うんうん、お父さんは、あなたに嫌なことはしてくる？
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. Does your dad do anything mean to you?

dialogue.content: 弟も3人でご飯を食べる時、ぼくだけ量が少なかったりするし
dialogue.English: Also, when the three of us, my dad and my brother and I, eat dinner, sometimes my portion is smaller,

dialogue.content: お兄ちゃんなんだからがまんできるよなっていって、ぼくにはくれなかったり
dialogue.English: and he says, "You're the big brother, so you can handle it," and doesn't give me more.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: お風呂のそうじとか、かいものとか行ってこいって
dialogue.English: He tells me to do things like clean the bath or go shopping.

dialogue.content: そっか、そっか、、悲しいね。お母さんがいないところでは、そんな感じなんだね。
dialogue.English: I see, I see... That's so sad. So that's what it's like when your mother isn't around.

dialogue.content: テレビも弟の見たい番組で、終わったらおとうさんがの野球にされて
dialogue.English: The TV is always on the show my brother wants to watch, and when that's over, my dad changes it to baseball.

dialogue.content: うん　お母さんがいない時がひどいの
dialogue.English: Yeah, it's worse when my mom isn't here.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: そっか、、、。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: うちはお母さんが夜いないことが多いから
dialogue.English: My mom is often not home at night, so...

dialogue.content: 3人になるのがこわい
dialogue.English: I'm scared when it's just the three of us.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれてありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.content: そんな状況なんだね。
dialogue.English: That's the situation you're in.

dialogue.content: ぼくがいない方がいいかなって思う
dialogue.English: I wonder if it would be better if I weren't here.

dialogue.content: その方がおとうさんもしあわせだろうし
dialogue.English: That way, my dad would be happier too.

dialogue.content: そんなことないよ。だって、優しいお兄ちゃんだもの。
dialogue.English: That's not true. You're such a kind big brother.

dialogue.content: お母さんもおとうさんがきげんがいい方がいいだろうし
dialogue.English: My mom would probably prefer it if my dad were in a good mood too.

dialogue.content: 弟はちょっとさみしがってくれるかも
dialogue.English: My little brother might miss me a little.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに感じるんだね。弟さんは、お兄ちゃん大好きなんだね！
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel. Your little brother must really love his big brother!

dialogue.content: お母さんは、どんな人？
dialogue.English: What is your mother like?

dialogue.content: あなたに優しい？
dialogue.English: Is she kind to you?

dialogue.content: うーん　最近ちょっとなまいきになってきた
dialogue.English: Um... he's gotten a little cheeky lately.

dialogue.content: お母さんは優しい
dialogue.English: My mom is kind.

dialogue.content: お母さんのこと大好きだから
dialogue.English: I love my mom, so...

dialogue.content: 心配かけたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to make her worry.

dialogue.content: うんうん、弟さんは元気なんだね。お母さん、大好きなのね。お母さんもあなたのことが大好きなんだもんね。
dialogue.English: I see, your brother is full of energy. You really love your mom, don't you? And I'm sure your mom loves you very much, too.

dialogue.content: そうかな
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: 心配かけたくないと思うくらい強い子なんだね。
dialogue.English: You're such a strong person to be thinking about not wanting to worry her.

dialogue.content: そうだよ。
dialogue.English: Yes, you are.

dialogue.content: でもおとうさんのこと好きみたいだから
dialogue.English: But she seems to like my dad.

dialogue.content: そうだね、お父さんのことも好きなんだよね。だから、どうすればいいか悩んでるんだよね。
dialogue.English: Right, she likes your dad, too. That's why you're struggling with what to do.

dialogue.content: お母さんには、お父さんがあなたにしてくることを伝えてみようと思わなかったのかな？
dialogue.English: Have you ever thought about telling your mom what your dad does to you?

dialogue.content: ぼくはお父さんはあんまりすきじゃない
dialogue.English: I don't really like my dad.

dialogue.content: お母さんには言えないです
dialogue.English: I can't tell my mom.

dialogue.content: お母さんが悲しませたくないから
dialogue.English: Because I don't want to make her sad.

dialogue.content: 信じてくれるか分からないし
dialogue.English: And I don't know if she'd believe me.

dialogue.content: お母さんがお父さんのことを好きなんだよね。言葉が足りなくてごめんね、伝わりにくかったね。そっか、信じてくれるか心配なんだね。
dialogue.English: It's because your mom likes your dad, right? I'm sorry, I didn't say that very well. I see, so you're worried about whether she'll believe you.

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: お母さんは、夜いないって言ってたけど、、、お仕事？
dialogue.English: You said your mom is often not home at night... is it because of work?

dialogue.content: ぼくよりおとうさんの言うことを信じると思う
dialogue.English: I think she'd believe my dad over me.

dialogue.content: そう感じるのは、どんなところからそう思うのかな？
dialogue.English: What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.content: うん　お母さんはかんごしなんです
dialogue.English: Yeah, my mom is a nurse.

dialogue.content: お父さんはお母さんの前だと態度が違うので、お母さんは僕たちが仲良くしていると思ってる
dialogue.English: My dad acts differently in front of my mom, so she thinks we get along well.

dialogue.content: お話が、行ったり来たりしてごめんね。お母さんは、素敵なお仕事をしているんだね。
dialogue.English: Sorry for jumping around. Your mother does wonderful work.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、。それは言いにくいよね。
dialogue.English: I see... That must make it very difficult to say anything.

dialogue.content: お母さんはすごいお仕事をしてます
dialogue.English: My mom does an amazing job.

dialogue.content: そうだね！命を助けているお仕事だものね。
dialogue.English: That's right! It's a job that saves lives.

dialogue.content: そんな素敵なお母さん、あなたが伝えてくることを信じてくれないと思うかな、、どう？
dialogue.English: Do you think such a wonderful mom wouldn't believe what you tell her?

dialogue.content: はい救急車で運ばれてくる人のところで働いてます
dialogue.English: Yes, she works with people who are brought in by ambulance.

dialogue.content: お母さん、かっこいいね！
dialogue.English: Your mom is so cool!

dialogue.content: うん、かっこいいです！
dialogue.English: Yeah, she's cool!

dialogue.content: でもうちにいないことが多いから
dialogue.English: But she's not home very often, so...

dialogue.content: 優しくて、強くて、素敵なお母さんにあなたも似ているんだね。
dialogue.English: You're kind, strong, and wonderful, just like your mom.

dialogue.content: ぼくお母さん似かな
dialogue.English: You think I'm like my mom?

dialogue.content: そうだよね、お母さんいてほしいよね。そうだと思うよ。
dialogue.English: That's right, you want your mom to be around more. And yes, I think you are like her.

dialogue.content: 本当のお父さんのこと憶えていない
dialogue.English: I don't remember my real dad.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね、小さい頃に別れちゃったのかな。
dialogue.English: I see. Did you part ways when you were very little?

dialogue.content: 寂しいよね。
dialogue.English: That must be lonely.

dialogue.content: お父さんは病気で死んだんです
dialogue.English: My dad died from an illness.

dialogue.content: 僕が赤ちゃんの時
dialogue.English: When I was a baby.

dialogue.content: そうだったんだね。うんうん
dialogue.English: Oh, I see. Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: お父さんが生きていてくれたら、ぼくこんなかなしくならなかったと思う
dialogue.English: If my dad were still alive, I don't think I would be this sad.

dialogue.content: そうだよね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに思ってしまうよね。
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: お父さんどうして死んじゃったのかな
dialogue.English: I wonder why my dad had to die.

dialogue.content: そうだね、もっと生きててほしかったよね。
dialogue.English: That's right. You wish he could have lived longer.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: その気持ち、お母さんに言ったことある？
dialogue.English: Have you ever shared those feelings with your mom?

dialogue.content: ううん
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: 言えない
dialogue.English: I can't.

dialogue.content: お母さん忙しいし
dialogue.English: My mom is busy,

dialogue.content: 頑張ってて、いつも疲れてるから
dialogue.English: she works hard, and she's always tired.

dialogue.content: そっか、そっか。優しいね。
dialogue.English: I see, I see. You're very considerate.

dialogue.content: ぼくは心配かけちゃいけないの
dialogue.English: I mustn't make her worry.

dialogue.content: そうかなー？
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: 本当にそうかなー？
dialogue.English: Is that really so?

dialogue.content: お母さん、帰ってくるといつも疲れた疲れたって
dialogue.English: When my mom comes home, she's always saying how tired she is.

dialogue.content: うんうん、頑張ってるからね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, because she works so hard.

dialogue.content: あとらしいおとうさんのことも気をつかってるし
dialogue.English: And she's also considerate of my new dad.

dialogue.content: ぼくあたらしいお父さんの秘密を知ってるんです
dialogue.English: I know a secret about my new dad.

dialogue.content: 多分なんですけど、
dialogue.English: Well, I think so, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん、そうなんだね。どんなこと？
dialogue.English: Oh, you do? What is it?

dialogue.content: いつもうちで仕事をしているってことになってるけど、
dialogue.English: He's supposed to be working from home all the time, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん（聞いています）
dialogue.English: Mm-hm (I'm listening).

dialogue.content: 少し前から仕事なんてしてないし、昼間はパチンコ行ってる
dialogue.English: He hasn't been working for a while now, and during the day he goes to the pachinko parlor.

dialogue.content: この前、駅の近くで見たから
dialogue.English: I saw him near the station the other day.

dialogue.content: そうだったんだね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: その時、弟さんは誰が見てるの？
dialogue.English: Who looks after your little brother at that time?

dialogue.content: 弟は保育園です
dialogue.English: My little brother is at daycare.

dialogue.content: そっか、弟さんは安心な場所にいるんだね。
dialogue.English: I see, so your little brother is in a safe place.

dialogue.content: うんそう一度だけパチンコ屋にいたよねって言ったらなぐられた
dialogue.English: Yeah. Once, I said to him, "You were at the pachinko parlor, weren't you?" and he hit me.

dialogue.content: それは、痛かったね。
dialogue.English: That must have hurt.

dialogue.content: そのこともお母さんに言えてないんだね。
dialogue.English: You haven't been able to tell your mom about that either, have you?

dialogue.content: うんそれにこわかって
dialogue.English: Yeah, and it was scary.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: そうだよね、怖かったね。
dialogue.English: Right, that must have been very scary.

dialogue.content: お母さんに言うなって言われてる
dialogue.English: He told me not to tell my mom.

dialogue.content: 言ったらほくを追い出すって
dialogue.English: He said if I tell him, he'll kick me out.

dialogue.content: あ
dialogue.English: Ah.

dialogue.content: それからかも
dialogue.English: Maybe it was since then...

dialogue.content: おとうさんがすごくいやなことをするようになったの
dialogue.English: that my dad started doing really mean things to me.

dialogue.content: そっか、、そこからなんだね。
dialogue.English: I see... So that's when it started.

dialogue.content: うんそんな気がしてきた
dialogue.English: Yeah, I'm starting to think so.

dialogue.content: ぼくどこかに行った方がいいかな
dialogue.English: Maybe I should go somewhere else.

dialogue.content: うんうん、教えてくれてありがとう。辛かったね。相談員が、思うことを言ってもいい？
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for telling me. That must have been so hard. Is it okay if I tell you what I think?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: これは、とても大切な相談です。ここに来てくれてありがとう。そして大切なお話しだからこそ、大人の介入が必要なお話しです。
dialogue.English: This is a very important issue. Thank you for coming here to talk about it. And because it's such an important matter, it's one that requires adult intervention.

dialogue.content: 大人の介入って？
dialogue.English: Adult intervention?

dialogue.content: どういう意味ですか
dialogue.English: What does that mean?

dialogue.content: 誰かにあなたを助けてもらうということ。だから。一緒に考えましょうね。
dialogue.English: It means having someone help you. So, let's think about this together.

dialogue.content: 助けてくれる　そんな人いるんですか
dialogue.English: Someone who will help me? Is there anyone like that?

dialogue.content: でもおとうさんにばれたら　こわい
dialogue.English: But if my dad finds out, I'm scared.

dialogue.content: ここにもうしこんだのもないしょです
dialogue.English: It's a secret that I even contacted this place.

dialogue.content: 学校でもらったカードに書いてあったから
dialogue.English: It was on a card I got from school.

dialogue.content: そっか、そうなんだね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how you found us.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 誰か、話しやすい大人の人はいる？
dialogue.English: Is there any adult you feel comfortable talking to?

dialogue.content: 例えば、
dialogue.English: For example,

dialogue.content: 先生とか、保健室の先生とか、お友達の親御さんとか、、、どうかな？
dialogue.English: a teacher, the school nurse, or one of your friends' parents... How about that?

dialogue.content: 友だちには言いたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to tell my friends.

dialogue.content: そうだね、知られたくないよね。ごめんね。
dialogue.English: Right, you wouldn't want them to know. I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: 保険の先生は時々保健室にいきます
dialogue.English: The school nurse... I go to the nurse's office sometimes.

dialogue.content: そっか、その時にお話しできる？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you think you could talk to her then?

dialogue.content: でも先生に言われて、お母さんやおとうさんに知れたら
dialogue.English: But what if the nurse tells them, and my mom and dad find out?

dialogue.content: うんうん、心配だよね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, that's a worry.

dialogue.content: うんこわいよ
dialogue.English: Yeah, it's scary.

dialogue.content: そうだね、怖いよね。でも、そのことも伝えてみるのはどうかな？
dialogue.English: Yes, it is scary. But how about telling her about that fear, too?

dialogue.content: 誰にも言う人いない
dialogue.English: I have no one to tell.

dialogue.content: 保険の先生信じられるのかな
dialogue.English: Can I trust the school nurse?

dialogue.content: お父さんが、あなたをなぐったことは絶対にいけないことなの。だから、誰かにあなたを助けてほしいと相談員は思います。
dialogue.English: Your father hitting you is absolutely not okay. That's why I, as your counselor, think you need someone to help you.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 助けてほしい
dialogue.English: I want help.

dialogue.content: そうだよね、あなたはお母さんに似て強い人だから
dialogue.English: I know. You're strong, just like your mom,

dialogue.content: 伝えられると思うけど、
dialogue.English: so I think you can tell her.

dialogue.content: 保年室の先生はどんな人かな？
dialogue.English: What kind of person is the school nurse?

dialogue.content: うん　こんど保健室に行ってみます
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll try going to the nurse's office next time.

dialogue.content: ありがとう、約束してくれて。
dialogue.English: Thank you for promising.

dialogue.content: 保険の先生はお母さんよりもっと年上の人です
dialogue.English: The school nurse is a lot older than my mom.

dialogue.content: 模試もなんだけど、
dialogue.English: Just in case, I mean,

dialogue.content: ごめんださい、間違えました。
dialogue.English: Sorry, I misspoke.

dialogue.content: （大丈夫です！）
dialogue.English: (It's okay!)

dialogue.content: そっか、優しそうな人でよかった。
dialogue.English: I see. I'm glad she seems like a kind person.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: もしもなんだけど、
dialogue.English: Just in case,

dialogue.content: 言えなかったら、近くのお巡りさんに伝えてみる方法もあります。
dialogue.English: if you can't tell her, there's also the option of telling a nearby police officer.

dialogue.content: おまわりさん？
dialogue.English: A police officer?

dialogue.content: そうです。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 事件みたいになっちゃう
dialogue.English: It'll turn into a big incident.

dialogue.content: 交番に行くなんてこわいよ
dialogue.English: It's scary to go to a police box.

dialogue.content: そうだよね。でももし、またあなたをなぐるようなことがあったらお巡りさんのところに逃げてほしいの。
dialogue.English: I understand. But if he ever hits you again, I want you to run to a police officer.

dialogue.content: うん　わかりました
dialogue.English: Okay, I understand.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そして、
dialogue.English: And,

dialogue.content: どうなったか、またここに来ておしえほしいのだけど、お約束できるかな？
dialogue.English: could you come back here and let me know how it goes? Can you promise that?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: わかった
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 待っていますね。
dialogue.English: I'll be waiting.

dialogue.content: 保険の先生に話してみる
dialogue.English: I'll try talking to the school nurse.

dialogue.content: うん、お話ししてみてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Yes, please do talk to her.

dialogue.content: では、時間になりました。
dialogue.English: Well, our time is up.

dialogue.content: うんそうしますこわいけど
dialogue.English: Yeah, I will. Even though it's scary.

dialogue.content: うんうん、さすがお兄ちゃん！強いね。
dialogue.English: Yes. You're such a strong big brother!

dialogue.content: 相談員も応援します。
dialogue.English: I'll be rooting for you.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お話し、終わっても大丈夫かな？
dialogue.English: Is it okay if we end our session now?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: だいじょうぶ
dialogue.English: It's okay.

dialogue.content: はい、ここにきてくれてありがとう。待ってますね。
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you for coming here. I'll be waiting for you.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: では、ここで終了しますね。
dialogue.English: Then, we'll end here.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much!)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそ、ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well.)

dialogue.content: （終了メッセージで大丈夫です）
dialogue.English: (A closing message is fine.)
